raw_context:
Tri-anim Health Services
distributes specialty medical equipment, devices, and day-to-day consumables for respiratory, anesthesia, critical, and neonatal care. They partner with major medical device manufacturers, including brand names like
Mercury Medical
, Philips, Ambu, Fisher & Paykel Healthcare, Teleflex, Medtronic, ICU Medical, Laerdal, and ReddyPort
Tri-anim Health Services
Key Manufacturers and Brands
Mercury Medical:
Resuscitation and airway management solutions.
Philips:
Diagnostic cardiology solutions and non-invasive ventilation masks (such as the AF541).
Ambu:
Airway management tools, including aScope videoscopes, King Vision laryngoscopes, and AuraGain laryngeal masks.
Fisher & Paykel Healthcare:
Respiratory humidification and obstructive sleep apnea/acute care devices.
Teleflex & Medtronic:
Critical care, anesthesia, and airway consumables.
ICU Medical:
Infusion therapy and critical care products.
Laerdal:
Resuscitation training and patient simulation tools.
ReddyPort:
Specialized non-invasive ventilation (NIV) accessories and elbow-mask maintenance systems.
Monaghan Medical:
Aerosol drug delivery and secretion clearance devices (like the Aerobika OPEP).
